result.requirement: The system shall dynamically adjust delivery fees and commissions based on real-time network congestion and predicted demand spikes.
result.business_need: The business needs to balance network capacity with revenue optimization during high-demand periods to prevent service degradation.
functional_behaviour: The system shall calculate a surge multiplier by analyzing current fleet utilization and predicted order volume for specific zones.
The system shall apply the calculated multiplier to standard delivery fees and platform commissions for orders within the affected zone.
The system shall display the adjusted pricing to the Customer before the Order Request is confirmed.
The system shall automatically revert pricing to standard rates once congestion metrics fall below the defined threshold.
The system shall log all surge pricing events with the specific time window and calculated multiplier for audit purposes.
related_information_requirements: Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents and the aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone.
Predictive data regarding anticipated order volumes and item popularity for specific zones and time windows based on historical patterns and current trends.
Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance between the store location and potential customer addresses, accounting for traffic patterns and route constraints.
The complete record of monetary exchange, detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and the net settlement amounts due to each party.
business_rules: Surge pricing must only be applied when the ratio of active orders to available delivery agents exceeds the configured capacity threshold.
The system must not apply surge pricing if the predicted wait time for the customer exceeds the maximum acceptable delay defined in the Service Area Definition.
Adjusted fees must be calculated using the highest multiplier observed within the specific time window to ensure consistency.
Pricing adjustments must be communicated to the Customer Profile before the Order Request is finalized.

acceptance_criteria.given: The system detects a predicted demand spike in a specific Delivery Zone Map area due to high order volume.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine calculates the surge multiplier and updates the pricing engine.
acceptance_criteria.then: The delivery fee and commission displayed to the Customer are increased by the calculated multiplier before the Order Request is confirmed.

acceptance_criteria.given: The system detects that network congestion has returned to normal levels in the affected zone.
acceptance_criteria.when: The pricing engine recalculates the surge multiplier based on current fleet capacity.
acceptance_criteria.then: The delivery fee and commission are automatically reverted to the standard base rate for subsequent Order Requests.
